intro.body: Fill in your listing below, set the status to "Active", and add at least one plan — then submit it for an admin to review.

cert.body: Tiers B and A are for certified trainers. Upload a coaching certification PDF for review — any Taiwan-recognized coaching certification qualifies. Tier B unlocks for this activity once approved.

cert.needFile: Please choose a PDF to upload.
cert.hintType: Certification must be a PDF file.
cert.tierANote: Tier A (plus competition proof): once this is approved, you'll also upload proof of a competition result to unlock Tier A.

certExp.title: {{activity}} qualification proof required
certExp.body: Tiers B and A don't require a coaching licence — upload relevant proof instead. Athletic: varsity records or race finishes (e.g. ITRA score, Taiwan 百岳 summit log); Experience: running/hiking club leadership, or positive Pacergo reviews. Tier B unlocks for this activity once approved.
certExp.label: Proof name
certExp.labelPlaceholder: e.g. ITRA score, 百岳 summit log, club leadership, etc.
certExp.pending: Your {{activity}} qualification proof is under review — Tier B unlocks for {{activity}} once it's approved.
certExp.rejected: Your last submission was rejected. Please upload valid qualification proof.

comp.title: {{activity}} competition experience required
comp.body: Tier A also needs proof of a competition result. Upload a PDF (e.g. an award certificate, placement record, or race result) for review — it unlocks Tier A for this activity once approved.
